title: Heavenly Eye Reappears
next_chapter_hook: The three-day countdown has begun. Chen Ji must complete his ultimate plan before the catastrophic disaster strikes, and the final fragment of Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant might be the key to breaking the deadlock.

text.content: His father's phantom was like a candle flame in the wind, dissolving into a wisp of blue smoke after speaking those final words. Chen Ji stood in place, his fingertips still retaining the icy cold sensation from touching the phantom. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew slightly warm, as if responding to some resonance in the depths of his bloodline. "Three bloodlines merging into one..." he murmured, repeating those four words, a complex light flickering in his eyes. Three bloodlines—Chen family, Ling family, and that sealed third bloodline. The three as one, the key to the fourth seal had been hidden within the bloodline itself all along.

At that moment, an ancient yet imposing aura descended upon this space without warning. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and the Tianji Record in his hand instinctively flipped to the first page—Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant trembled violently, as if sensing some fatal threat. "No need to be nervous." A voice familiar enough to send a chill down Chen Ji's spine came from behind him, "If this old man wanted to strike, you wouldn't have had the chance to touch that phantom just now." Ling Yuan stepped out from the shadows, each step striking the strings of Chen Ji's heart.

dialogue.content: "It seems what your father left you is more than just a riddle." Ling Yuan's gaze fell upon the faintly glowing fragment in Chen Ji's palm, a barely concealable greed flickering in his eyes, soon replaced by deeper wariness. He swept his sleeve, an invisible barrier enveloping both of them, "Three hundred and seventy-two disciples and twenty-one elders of the Tianqing Sect—every movement under this old man's observation. Do you think ordinary means could achieve this?"

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his heart churned like raging waves. The precise number Ling Yuan spoke, down to the individual, was far beyond idle boasting. He slowly turned, meeting those bottomless eyes, his tone calm to the point of indifference: "Elder, if you came here specially, it wasn't merely to flaunt your divine abilities to the junior, was it?" The Tianji Record Fragment's temperature was rising, Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant urgently conveying something in his mind—danger, extreme danger.

dialogue.content: "Flaunt?" Ling Yuan sneered, but the smile didn't reach his eyes, "Chen Ji, do you truly believe this old man doesn't know what you're scheming? The Tianji Record Fragment, your father's final message, the secret of three bloodlines merging—thought you hid it well, but from the moment you stepped into this secret chamber, every move you've made has been under the gaze of the Heavenly Eye." He paused, his voice dropping abruptly, "And now, that eye is coming to reap the harvest personally."

text.content: "The Heavenly Eye—the Eye of Heavenly Dao!" Chen Ji's heart shook violently, yet his face remained impassive. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm suddenly burned so intensely it nearly scorched him. Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant transmitted a cascade of fragmented information: the Tianji Record's aura had been detected, the kill order escalated, three days—three days! He suppressed the churning emotions and said coldly: "Elder, since you know the Heavenly Eye is coming, why risk meeting me? Could it be..." His gaze cut like a blade, directly piercing Ling Yuan, "You also have reasons that force you to cooperate with me?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan fell silent for a moment, and rare exhaustion actually appeared on that dignified face. "This old man cultivated for eight hundred years, survived three heavenly tribulations, thinking I had long seen through the workings of heavenly dao." He slowly raised his hand, fingertips凝聚出一缕与天机录光芒截然相反的幽暗之力, "Until I discovered—the Eye of Heavenly Dao has never treated anyone as a chess piece—including the prophets who have wielded the Tianji Record through the ages." That wisp of dark power coiled in his palm, faintly forming the雏形 of a vertical pupil.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that wisp of dark power, his pupils contracting sharply. This power—with a few similarities to the Tianji Record's foresight, yet bearing entirely opposite attributes. He understood instantly: "Elder can also... foresee?" Ling Yuan withdrew his hand, the dark power dissipating into nothing. "Not foresight, perception." His voice carried a hint of self-mockery, "The Tianji Record gazes into the future, while this old man can perceive the present—within a thousand li, any power fluctuation related to heavenly dao escapes not this old man's perception. Including that eye's gaze."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan displayed abilities that partially counter the Heavenly Eye, and revealed the catastrophic disaster in three days. Facing this sudden information, Chen Ji must respond—

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan主动示好, might as well hear his conditions first
choices.visible_cost: Reveal part of his trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the protection of Ling Yuan's perception ability
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's true intentions remain unclear

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Elder, since you possess the power to counter the Heavenly Eye, why seek out this 'waste' of a junior?" His tone carried a playful edge, "Speak—What do you want?"

choices.description: Ling Yuan's intentions are unclear, cooperating rashly carries too much risk
choices.risk_hint: After the crisis in three days, there may be no one to lend a hand

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, creating distance from Ling Yuan. "Elder, your kindness is appreciated, but—" He shifted his tone, a cold light flickering in his eyes, "This junior prefers to control his own destiny."

choices.description: Let Ling Yuan display more strength and information
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might expose more trump cards before leaving

text.content: Chen Ji didn't retreat; instead, he met Ling Yuan's eyes directly: "In three days the Heavenly Eye descends. Since Elder knows, surely you have a countermeasure? Let this junior first see Elder's leverage."

dialogue.content: "Clever." A flash of approval crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, then his expression turned solemn, "In three days, the Eye of Heavenly Dao will strike personally. This is not speculation—it's precise information this old man has perceived. That eye's aura has already locked onto the Tianqing Sect, onto you, Chen Ji." He traced a complex rune in the void, a cold vertical pupil manifesting at its center, "Moreover, its kill order has been upgraded. Anyone related to you by blood, anyone connected to you—all are on the death list."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression finally changed. Blood-related—his sister Chen Nian was still in the Holy Sect's grasp, her life uncertain. If the Heavenly Eye executes the kill order... He dared not think further. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with scorching heat. Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant flickered violently on the first page, seemingly urging him to decide. "What do you want, Elder?" Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, yet carried unmistakable sharpness, "Since you dare oppose the Heavenly Eye, surely you have preparations in place."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan studied Chen Ji, his eyes revealing complex, indecipherable emotions. After a moment, he spoke slowly: "This old man wants the Tianji Record in your hands—not all of it, just the first three pages." Chen Ji frowned, about to speak, but Ling Yuan raised a hand to stop him, "Don't refuse so quickly. This old man's condition: within three days, this old man will use perception to shield the Tianji Record's aura, preventing that eye from pinpointing its location. Simultaneously—" He drew an ancient jade slip from his sleeve, "This is the perception records this old man accumulated over eight hundred years. Perhaps useful to you."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that jade slip, calculating rapidly in his heart. Ling Yuan's terms seemed generous, yet harbored hidden dangers—he wanted not the entire Tianji Record, but only the first three pages. What did that mean? What was sealed on the first three pages? Why did Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant tremble violently? He drew a sharp breath, inspiration striking: "Elder wants the first three pages because within them is sealed..." His gaze turned sharp as a blade, "Something from the same source as Elder's perception power?" Ling Yuan's pupils slightly contracted, then burst into laughter.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, Chen Ji!" Ling Yuan's laughter ceased abruptly, his eyes blazing with astonishing brilliance, "No wonder the Tianji Record chose you—your insight exceeds even this old man's expectations." He clasped his hands behind his back, admitting: "Correct. The first three pages of the Tianji Record seal fragments of prophets' souls through the ages, and this old man's perception power was stolen from those fragments. When this old man failed to become the Tianji Record's inheritor, he carved his own path..." His voice carried pride, yet also bitterness, "But that path leads to one destination—war with the Heavenly Eye."

text.content: Chen Ji finally understood Ling Yuan's predicament. This eight-hundred-year-old monster, seemingly transcendent, had long been targeted by the Eye of Heavenly Dao—because he stole power that rightfully belonged to the Tianji Record. He suddenly laughed, the smile carrying a hint of mockery: "Elder, you and I are actually the same kind of people. Both are chess pieces on the Heavenly Eye's board, trying to overturn the game." He slowly raised the Tianji Record in his hand, "Three days is too short. This junior needs to examine those perception records first before deciding."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan proposed a deal: exchange the first three pages of the Tianji Record for his perception protection. Facing this dangerous yet tempting proposal, Chen Ji must decide his next move—

choices.description: The crisis in three days is too terrifying; must grasp every available resource
choices.visible_cost: Lose control of the first three pages of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ling Yuan's perception protection and the perception records jade slip
choices.risk_hint: The first three pages of the Tianji Record may seal crucial secrets

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while before finally nodding: "Very well. But this junior must examine those records first, confirm they're worth this price." He extended his hand, "The jade slip."

choices.description: Demand Ling Yuan surrender the perception records as a show of good faith first
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence without paying a price first
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might turn and leave

text.content: The corners of Chen Ji's mouth lifted slightly: "Elder conducts business with exquisite precision. This junior wishes to examine what's in this jade slip first before deciding if these three pages are worth that price." He stood his ground without yielding, "If Elder truly has sincerity, why not let this junior inspect the goods first?"

choices.description: The Tianji Record is his lifeblood; absolutely no concessions
choices.visible_reward: Maintain complete control over the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May face the Heavenly Eye alone in three days

text.content: Chen Ji slowly shook his head, his voice cold as ice: "Elder, the Tianji Record is this junior's foundation for survival; I cannot part with it. The crisis in three days, this junior will handle personally." He turned to leave, "Elder, please return."

Ling Yuan did not obstruct him, merely watching Chen Ji's retreating figure silently. As Chen Ji was about to cross the threshold of the secret chamber, the old man's voice drifted from behind: "Chen Ji, do you know why your father sent you to the Tianqing Sect?" Chen Ji's footsteps halted abruptly. Ling Yuan continued: "Because beneath the Tianqing Sect lies the second key to the three bloodlines merging. Your father's layout is far deeper than you imagine—and that key, this old man has guarded for eighty years on your behalf." Chen Ji spun around, his eyes blazing with brilliant light.

The atmosphere in the secret chamber froze solid. Chen Ji stared at Ling Yuan, his mind racing—his father never mentioned a second key in the letter, yet sent him to be a servant disciple at the Tianqing Sect. Now that he thought about it, this arrangement was too deliberate. "Does Elder mean..." His voice tightened slightly, "In Father's layout, you were also a piece?" Ling Yuan stroked his beard, his smile carrying deep meaning: "Your father failed to become the Tianji Record's inheritor, but he saw through the Heavenly Eye's nature earlier than I did. He chose to place his hopes on you—and this old man is the one guarding this seed for him."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm trembled more intensely. Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant seemed to be conveying something—but the information was too vague, like looking through a mist. He suddenly realized a key issue: the Tianji Record was always vague in its foresight regarding Chen Nian, and now Ling Yuan spoke of countless secrets in his father's layout... He suddenly spoke: "Elder just mentioned the Heavenly Eye's kill order upgraded, with all blood-related individuals on the list. My sister Chen Nian..." His voice turned icy cold, "How is she now?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly, rare complexity flickering in his eyes. "Holy Sect Saint Woman Ye Qing personally led the team, taking Chen Nian into the Northern Region's Forbidden Grounds." His voice was low, "That place... even this old man's perception cannot penetrate. But this old man can tell you one thing—Ye Qing doesn't intend to harm your sister. She is protecting her. Because on the Heavenly Eye's kill order, Chen Nian's name ranks even higher than yours." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his heart churning with monstrous waves. Ye Qing is protecting Chen Nian? What hidden truths lay behind this?

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with intense radiance—Chen Ji felt unprecedented power surge from the fragment,冲向他的神魂深处. This was... foresight! He had no time to think, allowing that force to pull him into a vision of the future. Three days later—above the Tianqing Sect, a giant vertical pupil slowly opened, its iris reflecting endless destruction. That was the Heavenly Eye's true form, a thousand times, ten thousand times more terrifying than he imagined. And beneath that vertical pupil's gaze, the entire Tianqing Sect was turning to ash...

Chen Ji violently snapped out of the vision, cold sweat beading on his forehead. The Heavenly Fate value had dropped a full five points at that instant—but he saw more crucial information. At the edge of that vision of universal destruction, he glimpsed a blurry figure standing at the entrance of the Northern Region's Forbidden Grounds, waving toward him in the distance. That was Chen Nian! Though he couldn't see his sister's face clearly, he sensed her presence distinctly. "Three days..." Chen Ji murmured softly, gripping the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, "Within three days, I must reach the Northern Region's Forbidden Grounds." Blazing determination burned in his eyes. Ling Yuan watched him silently, stroking his beard without speaking. Outside the secret chamber, the night wind wailed, as if composing a funeral dirge for the approaching catastrophe. The three-day countdown officially began.
